title: Strokes ended his playing in 1955
summary: His first stroke in 1955 ended his playing; the interviewer shares his own stroke; he has an old clarinet but cannot work his hands.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yeah. And my last stroke was last year.
Oh yeah? I had four strokes. Oh yeah? Yeah. What, it's affected your legs mostly?
Yeah? Most of your legs huh? Yeah. No. No.
No. No. No. Just one that was this leg. Uh huh.
I might not play yet. I got my own back then. That would be fun to try anyway.
Huh? It would be fun to try wasn't it? Yeah. It would be fun but I can't play like I usually.
Has your stroke affected your hands too?
I can't work my hands. No. I like to play with my kin but I ain't got them. I got one old clarinet back there but I ain't no good.
